faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Ayush Mission Kannur (NAM Kannur) in Kerala to fill up vacant healthcare positions on a contract basis for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for NAM Kannur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post announced under this official notification is Data Entry Operator. Candidates fulfilling the required educational qualifications are encouraged to apply through offline mode before the deadline.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Data Entry Operator post under this recruitment notification released by National Ayush Mission Kannur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess Any Graduation and a Govt. Approved DCA/PGDCA Course to be eligible for the Data Entry Operator position as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years as on 1st September 2026 for applicants applying for the Data Entry Operator position under National Ayush Mission Kannur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Data Entry Operator post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of 14175/- as per the guidelines and norms of the National Ayush Mission.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled offline application form for the NAM Kannur Data Entry Operator recruitment is 08-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches on time.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to take place on 12-10-2026. Candidates must bring all original certificates during the interview process.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for NAM Kannur Recruitment 2026 is Offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it by post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF and visit the official website by checking the important links section provided in this article for accurate updates.
